verified: pv magazine, citing the ministry's conference announcement, reports the 200 MW solar and 100 MW/400 MWh BESS plans, the build-own-operate structure with NEPCO as offtaker and storage beneficiary, the $100–130 million and $70–90 million investment ranges, and the February and March 2027 prequalification dates.
unconfirmed: The cost ranges are planning estimates rather than bid or contract prices; locations, tariffs, financing terms and the storage technology supplier are all undisclosed, and no project has been financed or built.

verified: 约旦能源与矿产资源部在首届约旦-欧盟投资会议上公布这两个项目，均采用 BOO 模式，由国家电力公司购电并作为储能项目受益方；两项目投资区间分别为 1 亿至 1.3 亿美元和 7000 万至 9000 万美元，预审时间表为 2027 年 2 月和 3 月，这些内容出自该部公开表态及约旦新闻社报道。
unconfirmed: 项目是否已有确定资金、选址、并网方案和最终装机规模；投资额与时间均为部委规划数字，尚无招标文件或合同佐证，报道也未说明储能项目的购电或容量付费安排。

titles.en: Jordan to seek private investors for 200 MW solar and 400 MWh battery storage
titles.zh: 约旦拟招标 200 MW 光伏与 100 MW/400 MWh 储能，资格预审定于 2027 年初
